comment: The sources of Retake's own ffmpeg (scripts/build-ffmpeg.mjs): every archive pinned by URL and sha256. The build refuses an archive whose sha256 differs. The same list is the written source offer in apps/desktop/licenses/ffmpeg/. The x264 (GitLab) and libvpx (GitHub) archives are generated on request by the forge and are not guaranteed byte-stable: a pin that starts failing means re-verify and re-pin, never skip the check (the verified archives are kept for the release, part e).

sources.name: ffmpeg
sources.license: GPL-2.0-or-later as configured (--enable-gpl, libx264); LGPL-2.1-or-later otherwise
sources.verification: upstream publishes an OpenPGP signature (.asc, key FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8, ffmpeg-devel) and no checksum; the key was not on the build machine, so the sha256 was matched against an independent pin of the same release instead

sources.name: x264
sources.verification: no upstream checksum; the stable branch snapshot (archive comment = this commit) and this commit's archive have identical trees; sha256 recorded at download

sources.name: libvpx
sources.verification: no upstream checksum (a generated tag archive); sha256 recorded at download, and it matches an independent pin of the same tag
